summary: Audited all 45 SVGs in public/art/ by rendering a 160x120 card-viewport HTML/PNG contact sheet in headless Chrome, identified 28 wonky or off-style illustrations (such as caterpillar's leaf duck-bill, heron's taco-shell body and stick neck, o2.svg reading as 62, freshwater-snail's triangle cone shell, and overlapping circle seams in frog/grasshopper/riparian-tree/water-snake), and redrew all 28 from scratch as clean flat naturalist field-guide illustrations in the shared DESIGN.md palette.

done.what: Commit redrawn public/art/ SVGs and generate before/after contact sheets

evidence.test: Commit redrawn public/art/ SVGs and generate before/after contact sheets

decisions.text: Biased toward redrawing any illustration with overlapping interior stroke seams, geometric shortcuts (triangle snail shell, X-stick algae, traffic-cone P triangles on weather/algae cards), or ambiguous silhouettes, resulting in 28 full redraws out of 45 SVGs.
